items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: My father was a bass player and he was my teacher.

ctx.x: It would be an eye opener. Well let me ask you about your process of gaining wisdom. I understand you come from a two bass family?
Well a one bass family. I mean well I’m the second bass. My father was a bass player and he was my teacher.
Do you have an early — what’s your earliest recollection of your father playing gigs?
